summary: The YAML inventory plugin reads YAML inventories starting with the all group and hosts/vars/children entries; to set all group vars, all must be the first entry, and the file needs a configured extension.
questions: How do I structure a YAML inventory file?
Why aren't my all group vars applied in YAML inventory?
Is the YAML inventory plugin enabled by default?

answer_card.title: YAML inventory plugin
answer_card.answer_md:
A YAML inventory should start with the `all` group and use `hosts`, `vars` and `children` entries. Sub-entries under a host are its variables; `children` groups can have their own hosts/vars/children. The file must use a configured valid extension.

To set vars for `all` in the file, `all` must be the **first** entry. The plugin is enabled by default.
